name: kunla
description: Kunla: one record of every person's and AI's work for the team, and the decisions it needs from you.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

SETUP_TOKEN.description: Any long random text (a password manager can make one). Kunla asks for it once, when you set it up at **/app/**, so nobody else can claim your Kunla first. Keep it somewhere safe.

LEASE_MINUTES.description: Minutes an AI's claim on a task stays alive without a heartbeat. `30` is a good default.
